=== nsf370 d2 round 1: the rendezvous, live (TSTSCTM) ===
role: 'GATE'
  PASS: the job starts UNAUTHORISED (TESTAUTH FCTN=1 == 0)
  PASS: self-auth (SVC 244) -- ssct_new/ssct_install need supervisor state, exactly as they do inside NSFS
--- two names on the real SSI chain ---
  PASS: A: NSZ1 registers on the real chain
  PASS: A: NSZ1 is found under NSZ1 -- the control for every refusal below
  PASS: A: NSZ2 is NOT found while only NSZ1 is chained
  PASS: A: NSZ2 registers alongside NSZ1
  PASS: A: NSZ2 finds its OWN anchor
  PASS: A: ...which is not NSZ1's -- two names, two anchors
  PASS: A: and NSZ1 is undisturbed -- a one-name test cannot see this
  PASS: A: NSZ1 removes
  PASS: A: a removed SSCT is not found -- and it WAS found, four assertions up, on this same chain
  PASS: A: removing NSZ1 left NSZ2 ALONE -- removal is by name, not a sweep
  PASS: A: removal SURVIVES a corrupt anchor -- ssct_remove_by_name never dereferences SSCTSUSE (ADR-0048 5.2)
  PASS: A: ...and it is gone
  PASS: A: removing an absent name reports failure, not success
--- the full API under this job's own name ---
  PASS: B: the TIOT jobname reads
  jobname 'MBTTEST ' -> key 'MBTT' tail 'EST '
  PASS: B: nothing under our name yet -> NONE
  PASS: B: register
  PASS: B: find returns OK -- eye, version and identity all agree through the real chain
  PASS: B: ...and hands back our anchor
  PASS: B: a second register under the same name is REFUSED (the IEF612I case -- never a second chain entry)
  PASS: B: remove
  PASS: B: and it is gone
  PASS: A: NOTHING LEFT CHAINED -- an SSCT this test leaked would be registered until IPL and would block a start under that name
